A few words from me

A Birthday Letter 💌

♡ ✦ ♡

My Dear Akhya,

If I could wrap a feeling and give it to you as a birthday gift, I think it would be this: the quiet happiness I feel whenever I get to share a moment with you.

Looking through our pictures makes me realise how many little moments have become precious memories. The smiles, the silly moments, the random pictures, the days that seemed ordinary at the time — somehow, they all became pieces of something I want to keep close.

On your birthday, I don't just wish you a happy day. I wish you a year where you feel loved, appreciated, peaceful and genuinely happy. I hope you laugh a little louder, dream a little bigger, and always remember that you deserve beautiful things.

Thank you for being a part of so many memories that make me smile. And if I had to choose one thing to wish for today, it would simply be this: may your smile never run out of reasons. ❤️

Happy Birthday, Akhya. You are a very special part of my story, and I'm really glad our story has these little moments in it.

Always cheering for you,
— Aviral ❤️
